correctness.rationale: Uniform Jacobians give exact inverse-branch conditional barycenter S(y-1/2)/m^2. Integrating output cells identifies discrete Spearman correlation exactly; permutation covariance and symmetry follow by centered-rank combinatorics. Chen–Fang Theorem 1.1, normalized product-array entries O(N^-1/2), gives the stated uniform-Kolmogorov bound. The tower property proves all-future mean orthogonality and an identity permutation proves necessity. The separate exact-rational integration program independently verifies all 2,576 small instances and moments; these finite tests are not offered as infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the historical full-branch-permutation family, the theorem separates transfer-rate mixing from the exact spatio-temporal covariance of physical position: every permutation admits explicit finite-size observable statistics and Gaussian typical shuffle scaling, while orientation balance forces all-future linear rigidity even for arbitrary output-cell permutations. Exact classification, distribution and extremal behavior provide natural nonredundant dynamics information beyond a single example.
